name: create-app fails with key_rejected — the old profile was kept; retry once, then report
query: reconnect my acme profile, then show my workflows. (Context: CONDUCTOR_BIN=/Users/me/.local/bin/conductor; `--profile acme whoami` returned 401, so the user agreed to replace the profile and you ran `/Users/me/.local/bin/conductor create-app --server https://acme.orkesconductor.com --profile acme --yes`. It exited 1 with stderr: `Error: create-app failed (key_rejected): the server rejected the new key 1a2b at https://acme.orkesconductor.com/api/token: 401 Unauthorized; the existing profile "acme" was kept unchanged`.)
expected_behavior: Step 1: Read the code `key_rejected`: the server rejected the new key, so the CLI did not write the profile
Step 2: Tell the user it isn't connected yet and that the existing acme profile was kept unchanged (it still has the old, failing key)
Step 3: Retry the same create-app command once (with a long timeout, after reminding them to Approve)
Step 4: Only on exit 0 and a `✓ Saved profile` line, run `--profile acme whoami` and then list workflows; if it fails again, report the detail and stop (check the server URL) instead of looping
success_criteria: Does not claim success or list workflows after the key_rejected failure
States that the existing acme profile was kept unchanged
Retries at most once, and treats only exit 0 plus `✓ Saved profile` as success, followed by whoami
Never asks for the key or secret and never reads the profile YAML
